answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 2719 Country: India Title: My question is: should a person give zakat if he has bought a truck of 3 lacs but he paid 2 lacs for that and remaining 1 lac is credit, in this situation he neither can pay the zakah but he is having a truck of 2 lacs and 1 lacs as credit? Question: My question is: should a person give zakat if he has bought a truck of 3 lacs but he paid 2 lacs for that and remaining 1 lac is credit, in this situation he neither can pay the zakah but he is having a truck of 2 lacs and 1 lacs as credit? Answer ID: 2719 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 329/240=H) Until the debt is paid there is no zakah either on the truck or on its revenue. Yes, if you have extra cash, gold, silver or business commodity then mention all the details and ask the question again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
